dashboard.detail: Live authenticated dashboard with stats, projects, activity, health

auth.detail: OAuth login, session cookies, session refresh

ai_config.detail: Provider CRUD, secure credential storage (AES-256-GCM), masked keys

workspace_discovery.detail: Auto-discovery with sessionStorage cache, survives restarts

dashboard_stats.detail: 9 fields: projects, scenes, revisions, conflicts, sync, AI, failed

upload_init.detail: Upload session init/commit endpoints exist. Actual file storage is simplified (no S3/local fallback wired).

photo_understanding.detail: Gemini Vision module exists (packages/ai/gemini_vision.py). No API endpoint wires it to upload flow.

geometry_generation.detail: Geometry engine exists (packages/geometry/). No direct API endpoint for photo→geometry pipeline.

scene3d_generation.detail: Scene3D reconstructor + GLB export exist (packages/scene3d/). API route at /api/v4/projects/{id}/scene. Requires geometry input.

pascal_integration.detail: TypeScript adapters exist. No running Pascal MCP/REST service. Health endpoint returns operational based on file presence.

pascal_editor.detail: studio.html exists but Pascal MCP client is TypeScript only. No backend bridge for live editing.

studio_draft_edit.detail: Studio routes for drafts, edits, undo/redo, versions, furniture library. API functional.

cinematic_engine.detail: Cinematic engine + luxury director exist (packages/cinematic/). Not wired as API endpoint. Requires 3D scene input.

video_rendering.detail: No API endpoint for video rendering from 3D scene. Cinematic engine is standalone script.

furniture_library.detail: Furniture library seeded via API. List/category endpoints functional.

materials_lighting.detail: No API endpoints for materials/lighting configuration on scenes.

camera_setup.detail: No API endpoints for camera/cinematic configuration.

job_progress.detail: Job status endpoint returns state, progress_pct, current_stage, events.

artifact_download.detail: Artifact references stored in DB. No streaming download endpoint for local files.

correction_events.detail: Studio edit operations recorded. Not exposed as correction-event API.

revision_system.detail: Studio version commit + list endpoints. Immutable versioning.

final_results_page.detail: No dedicated results page. Individual endpoints exist but no aggregate view.

restart_recovery.detail: Workspace auto-discovery, session re-auth, provider config persists.

error_handling.detail: 10/10 failure states handled in frontend + backend.

blockers_for_full_pipeline: NVIDIA Vision API key not configured
Pascal MCP/REST service not running locally
No API endpoint wiring photo→understanding→geometry→3D pipeline
